## 36bf1fb8975c

**Issue found: the ordinary generator never teaches deletion under a zero
header.** The canonical rule replaces every nonzero body cell with the header
value in its column, including zero. Across 600 generated draws, all 5,614 body
cells appeared only under nonzero headers; there were zero body cells under a
zero header and zero active headers without a body cell. Thus this rival fits
every sampled generated row:

> Recolor a body cell from its header only when the header is nonzero;
> otherwise preserve the body cell.

Exact counterexample:

```text
input       authority     rival
204         204           204
011         004           014
000         000           000
```

The exact canonical Racket authority produced `004` on the second row because
the body cell in column 1 is replaced by header value 0. The rival preserves
that cell as 1. The canonical examples already contain this branch, but the
generator’s normal distribution omits it. Evidence and replay code are in
`checks/audits/adversarial_census.json` and
`checks/audits/adversarial_census.py`.
